newsitem.title: GHANA: Ashanti Goldfields drags Ghana bourse down steeply.
newsitem.headline: Ashanti Goldfields drags Ghana bourse down steeply.

text.p: Falling world gold prices hit the Ghana Stock Exchange on Monday, with a steep decline in Ashanti Goldfields Co shares dragging the bourse index to one of its biggest one-day falls.
The GSE All-Share Index fell 4.49 points to close at 361.88 points from 366.37 on Friday.

Ashanti, the bourse's weightiest stock, fell 1,800 cedis to 23,200 cedis. Two other issues declined and one advanced. Total volume at 72,200 shares traded was heavy compared with 17,820 shares changing hands on Friday.
Traders cited a depressed gold market for Ashanti's fall.
"There are signs gold might plummet further with fears of furure gold sales by European central banks looming on the horizon," one broker said.
World Gold prices tottered on the verge of 20-month lows after the bearish sentiment of last week swept through the markets again on Monday. ($=1,730 cedis)
